title: Black Hat USA 2025 | Unmasking Supply Chain Attacks via Application Behaviour

know it's the second day and everyone's
kind of slowly moving along. So, I
appreciate everyone's time to come hear
about uh our very exciting project. It's

definitely the most interesting project

name is Dagmay Mugetta and I'm here

>> Hi everyone. Uh, thanks for coming. I've

seven years now, and that's been the
entirety of my research career. Um, one
fun fact about me is if you ask me to
strap on a parachute and jump out of a
